description:
Goal
After the generic identity/surface fix lands, remove temporary affordances that avoided or tolerated the broken bridge and make the post-fix invariants fail loud.

Required work
- Re-evaluate the fz-bin.16 bridge-avoidance scaffold in Enum take/drop/split. Remove it only if the generic shared-bridge fix makes the simpler reduce-based implementation green and clearer.
- Re-enable enum_tier0 across interp/run/build and remove its fz-f98 deferrals once the regression targets are green.
- Coordinate with fz-x2n: deterministic_callable_boundary_fallback remains deleted/fail-loud work, but only after fz-f98 establishes the invariant that a materialized callable value has one coherent publication contract or arrives through a publication position.
- Update .agent docs and user guides only where the code-level facts changed; do not document temporary scaffolding as architecture.

Checks
- enum_tier0, enum_take_drop_split, range_enumerable, map_enumerable green on interp/run/build.
- cargo test --lib.
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.
title: Remove reduce bridge scaffolds and harden post-fix callable invariants
